description.value: Hai Chi Em is a cozy, modern Vietnamese restaurant on Kingsway in Vancouver, run by a sibling team with a Saigon-trained head chef who blends comforting classics like pho and bún with bold creative dishes and Vietnamese-inspired cocktails. The spot has been featured in Noms Magazine as one of Vancouver's freshest modern Vietnamese gems and holds a 4.7-star Google rating. Touring cyclists will find a welcoming dine-in space with online ordering and pickup options, accommodating a range of dietary needs.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 87m; rack (4 spaces) at 88m; stands (6 spaces) at 93m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website (haichiem.ca) is fully accessible and provides rich evidence. The OSM phone number (+1 604 566 3989) does not appear anywhere on the website, which consistently lists +1 604-213-0999 across all pages; I use the website value and flag the discrepancy. OSM opening hours (Mo-Fr 10:00-17:00; Sa-Su off) are also substantially different from website hours, flagged as a concern. Takeout is confirmed by 'DINE-IN/PICKUP' labels on all menu items and an online ordering system; vegetarian/GF accommodation is confirmed in the FAQ; no bike infrastructure or washroom evidence appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1 604 566 3989 but the website consistently lists +1 604-213-0999 across all pages; website value used. A third number (+1 604 301-0281) appears once in the FAQ for reservation changes only.
OSM opening_hours (Mo-Fr 10:00-17:00; Sa-Su off) differ substantially from hours shown on the website; OSM hours appear outdated and should be updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating Vietnamese restaurant with a live website, confirmed address, and online ordering. Straightforward inclusion.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ states: 'We can suggest dishes that are gluten-friendly, dairy-free, nut-aware, and vegetarian.' Menu also includes multiple tofu and mushroom dishes
